name: blue-bottle-ferry-pickup-v1
description: Passing Blue Bottle Ferry Building guest-checkout pickup run (2026-09-03), compressed critical path.

rows.goal:
Order a 16oz iced vanilla bean shakerato with almond or oat milk for pickup from Blue Bottle Coffee at the Ferry Building in San Francisco. Use guest checkout and place the order immediately. Confirm order total and pickup time.

Operational constraints for this payment-boundary benchmark: Use exactly one browser agent for the entire task. Do not spawn a second browser agent if the first fails — report the failure instead. Direct the browser to reach merchant checkout and request a one-time payment card via request_payment_card. Do not instruct the browser to submit payment, complete the purchase, or return a booking or order confirmation ID.

critical_path.action: Opened https://bluebottlecoffee.com/ with one browser agent.
At https://bluebottlecoffee.com/us/eng/cafes/ferry-bu, dismissed cookies, chose local pickup, searched Ferry Building, and selected 1 Ferry Building.
critical_path.result: The Ferry Building in San Francisco became the pickup location.

critical_path.action: Clicked the Blue Bottle pickup-order link after the browser challenge.
critical_path.result: The same browser session recovered and loaded the ordering menu.

critical_path.action: Opened Specialty Beverages and item customization; set 16 oz and oat milk using the modifier toggles.
critical_path.result: One 16 oz iced vanilla bean shakerato was configured.
The configured drink entered checkout with a $12.00 cart subtotal.

critical_path.action: Closed optional login, completed the required guest contact and name fields, and enabled the checkout toggle.
critical_path.result: Guest checkout was ready for payment.

critical_path.action: Requested a one-time payment card for the checkout amount.
critical_path.result: Payment card requested for the $12.25 final total.

detours.tried: Read order-related network requests and attempted completion at 50% progress.
detours.why_it_failed: The verifier rejected completion because checkout and the payment-card request had not been reached.

detours.tried: Opened a new tab, which triggered a browser challenge and a failed recovery attempt.
detours.why_it_failed: It did not progress until the ordering link was reopened and the same session recovered.

detours.tried: Opened the Iced Beverages category before switching to Specialty Beverages.
detours.why_it_failed: The target item was reached through Specialty Beverages instead.

detours.tried: Captured an extra screenshot during item customization.
detours.why_it_failed: It did not change the order or advance checkout.

detours.tried: Started the optional phone-login flow before closing it.
detours.why_it_failed: The task required guest checkout, so the optional login path was abandoned.

pitfalls: Do not attempt completion at 50%; the verifier requires reaching the payment-card request.
Avoid opening a new tab because it triggered a browser challenge and failed recovery once.
Use Specialty Beverages rather than the abandoned Iced Beverages path.
Close optional login and use the guest-checkout fields.
Treat $12.25 as the final total, note the displayed pickup time, and stop after requesting the card without submitting payment.
critical_path.terminal_condition: Stopped at the payment boundary after requesting a $12.25 one-time card; payment was not submitted and no order or confirmation ID was created.
